cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The depot shuts at six and your mother's waiting at the station. Those are two stops, not one errand. Which comes first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parcel is her birthday present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That explains its purpose, not its priority. Mother or parcel, please; I need a route before I start driving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Parcel. I'll ring Mum and explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's calling me now. Shall I answer before leaving, or let it ring while I drive to the depot? Please don't schedule both for the same minute.

reason: Use precise distinctions between purpose, priority and departure time to make A demand a choice; keep the call before departure rather than assume hidden movement.
